items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: Etta has collaborated with such greats as ... Kenny Burrell ... both in concert and on recordings.

ctx.x: Song-stylist Etta Jones grew up in New York City and began her singing career as a teenager in Buddy Johnson’s band. Since then Etta has collaborated with such greats as J.C. Heard, Oliver Nelson, Earl “Fatha” Hines, Jack McDuff, Kenny Burrell, Cedar Walton and many others, both in concert and on recordings. She has toured Europe and Asia, and has recorded for RCA Victor, Jubilee, Prestige, Muse and HighNote Records. Ms. Jones earned a gold record for her recording “Don’t Go To Strangers,” a Grammy nomination for…
Etta was interviewed in Clinton, New York on October 2, 1998, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
